zh-CN.headlineFact: AI标识、创业热度与三场风险定义今日行动
zh-CN.headlineView: 经营信号与全球安全警报同时进入决策表
zh-CN.headlineFull: AI标识、创业热度与三场风险定义今日行动；经营信号与全球安全警报同时进入决策表
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟AI透明规则、跨境税费和美国创业申请直接影响经营；夏威夷飓风、印尼地震、霍尔木兹航运、法国社媒法与阿富汗危机构成今天的全球图景。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正有用的新闻，会被翻译成合规、现金流与风险清单。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先把今天会动的数字圈起来。

en-US.headlineFact: AI labels, startup activity and three risk fronts define today's action
en-US.headlineView: operating signals and global safety alerts now share one decision sheet
en-US.headlineFull: AI labels, startup activity and three risk fronts define today's action; operating signals and global safety alerts now share one decision sheet
en-US.intro: EU AI transparency rules, parcel duties and US business applications shape operating decisions, while Hurricane Lala, an Indonesia earthquake, Hormuz shipping, France's social-media ruling and Afghanistan's crisis complete today's picture.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Useful news is translated into compliance, cash-flow and risk checklists.
en-US.doudouQuote: Circle the numbers that can move today.

sources.title: Quick Facts: Transparency rules for AI systems

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟低价包裹每件3欧元关税进入对账期
zh-CN.headlineView: 卖家必须把税费、承运与退货放进同一张毛利表
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟低价包裹每件3欧元关税进入对账期；卖家必须把税费、承运与退货放进同一张毛利表
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟自7月1日起取消150欧元以下包裹关税豁免并临时按每件商品征收3欧元；运行六周后，商品件数、IOSS、承运费、退货和前台税费必须逐单核对。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 新税费最怕被藏在平均运费里，必须逐件核算。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 三欧元很小，乘上订单量就会长大。

en-US.headlineFact: The EU's EUR3 per-item parcel duty has entered reconciliation season
en-US.headlineView: sellers need duty, carrier fees and returns in one margin sheet
en-US.headlineFull: The EU's EUR3 per-item parcel duty has entered reconciliation season; sellers need duty, carrier fees and returns in one margin sheet
en-US.intro: The EU removed the duty exemption for parcels under EUR150 on July 1 and introduced a temporary EUR3 duty per item; after six weeks, item counts, IOSS, carrier charges, returns and checkout tax need order-level reconciliation.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A new levy becomes dangerous when it hides inside average shipping cost; calculate it item by item.
en-US.doudouQuote: Three euros looks small until order volume multiplies it.

sources.title: E-commerce: 150 EUR customs duty exemption threshold to be removed as of 2026

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟AI生成内容透明规则已进入执行期
zh-CN.headlineView: 来源标记、用户提示与人工审核成为上线条件
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟AI生成内容透明规则已进入执行期；来源标记、用户提示与人工审核成为上线条件
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟AI法案第50条自8月2日起适用，涵盖聊天机器人提示、机器可读标记以及部分深度伪造和公共利益文本标签；罚款最高可达1500万欧元或全球年营收3%。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 生成能力上线时，来源标记与人工审核也要一起上线。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 会生成还不够，还得告诉大家它怎么来的。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: EU transparency rules for AI-generated content are now in force
en-US.headlineView: provenance marks, user notices and human review are launch requirements
en-US.headlineFull: EU transparency rules for AI-generated content are now in force; provenance marks, user notices and human review are launch requirements
en-US.intro: Article 50 of the EU AI Act has applied since August 2, covering chatbot notices, machine-readable marking and labels for some deepfakes and public-interest text; fines can reach EUR15 million or 3% of global annual turnover.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When generation goes live, provenance marking and human review should go live with it.
en-US.doudouQuote: Generating is not enough; tell people where it came from.

sources.title: Transparency obligations under Article 50 of the AI Act

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国7月企业申请升至578926份
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司要用验证速度筛掉伪需求
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国7月企业申请升至578926份；一人公司要用验证速度筛掉伪需求
zh-CN.intro: 美国人口普查局数据显示，7月经季调企业申请环比增长8.1%，预计四个季度内形成29959家有工资税义务的新企业；申请热度提高了竞争，也放大了快速验证的重要性。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 申请热度不是收入，真正的护城河是更快验证和更短回款。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 开张的人变多了，先找到第一笔真订单。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: US business applications rose to 578,926 in July
en-US.headlineView: solo firms need faster validation to filter false demand
en-US.headlineFull: US business applications rose to 578,926 in July; solo firms need faster validation to filter false demand
en-US.intro: The Census Bureau reports seasonally adjusted business applications rose 8.1% in July, with 29,959 payroll-tax startups projected within four quarters; stronger entry increases competition and the value of rapid validation.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Application activity is not revenue; the moat is faster validation and shorter time to cash.
en-US.doudouQuote: More doors are opening, so find the first real order.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 一级飓风Lala逼近夏威夷大岛
zh-CN.headlineView: 强风、暴雨与沿海风险需要同步准备
zh-CN.headlineFull: 一级飓风Lala逼近夏威夷大岛；强风、暴雨与沿海风险需要同步准备
zh-CN.intro: 美国国家飓风中心通报，Lala最大持续风约65节，中心位于夏威夷大岛以南并向西北移动；居民和运营方需同时准备停运、备援、撤离与沿海防护。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 预警的价值，在于风雨到来前完成停运、备援与撤离选择。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先充电装水，别等风来才找清单。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：夏威夷飓风。

en-US.headlineFact: Category 1 Hurricane Lala approaches Hawaii's Big Island
en-US.headlineView: wind, rain and coastal risk require one preparedness plan
en-US.headlineFull: Category 1 Hurricane Lala approaches Hawaii's Big Island; wind, rain and coastal risk require one preparedness plan
en-US.intro: The National Hurricane Center reported Lala with maximum sustained winds near 65 knots south of the Big Island and moving northwest; residents and operators need shutdown, backup, evacuation and coastal plans.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A warning creates value when shutdown, backup and evacuation choices are made before the weather arrives.
en-US.doudouQuote: Charge devices and store water before the wind finds the checklist.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 苏门答腊北部发生6.9级深源地震
zh-CN.headlineView: 无海啸与绿色警报不替代现场核查
zh-CN.headlineFull: 苏门答腊北部发生6.9级深源地震；无海啸与绿色警报不替代现场核查
zh-CN.intro: 美国地质调查局定位震中在Pematangsiantar西北约15公里、深约173公里，海啸标记为零且初步损失警报为绿色；本地伤情、基础设施与余震仍需持续核查。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 震级只是第一层信息，深度、暴露人口与现场回报决定真正风险。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 地图先给范围，安全还得听现场。

en-US.headlineFact: A magnitude 6.9 deep earthquake struck northern Sumatra
en-US.headlineView: no tsunami and a green alert do not replace local checks
en-US.headlineFull: A magnitude 6.9 deep earthquake struck northern Sumatra; no tsunami and a green alert do not replace local checks
en-US.intro: USGS located the quake about 15 km northwest of Pematangsiantar at roughly 173 km depth, with no tsunami flag and a preliminary green loss alert; local impacts, infrastructure and aftershocks still require verification.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Magnitude is only the first layer; depth, exposed population and field reports define real risk.
en-US.doudouQuote: The map gives a boundary; safety still depends on the ground.

sources.title: M 6.9 - 15 km NNW of Pematangsiantar, Indonesia

zh-CN.headlineFact: 霍尔木兹风险继续压住全球航运
zh-CN.headlineView: 威胁正在沿保险、库存与交期传导
zh-CN.headlineFull: 霍尔木兹风险继续压住全球航运；威胁正在沿保险、库存与交期传导
zh-CN.intro: 美国海事局有效警告称，商业船舶仍面临导弹、武装无人机和无人艇威胁；国际海事组织截至7月27日已确认62起相关事件和17名海员死亡。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 航道风险会沿保险、库存与交期传到每一家企业。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 海上绕一步，账单会走很远。

en-US.headlineFact: Hormuz risk continues to constrain global shipping
en-US.headlineView: the threat is moving through insurance, inventory and delivery times
en-US.headlineFull: Hormuz risk continues to constrain global shipping; the threat is moving through insurance, inventory and delivery times
en-US.intro: An active US Maritime Administration advisory says commercial vessels still face missiles, armed drones and unmanned surface vessels; the IMO had confirmed 62 related incidents and 17 seafarer deaths by July 27.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A shipping-lane risk reaches every business through insurance, inventory and lead time.
en-US.doudouQuote: One detour at sea sends the bill a long way.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 法国法院否决未满15岁社媒全面禁令
zh-CN.headlineView: 儿童保护必须同时满足比例与隐私保障
zh-CN.headlineFull: 法国法院否决未满15岁社媒全面禁令；儿童保护必须同时满足比例与隐私保障
zh-CN.intro: 法国宪法委员会认为全面禁令对表达自由与隐私构成不成比例限制，且年龄核验缺少充分法律保障；政府需要设计更精准、可执行的新方案。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 保护未成年人需要证据和比例原则，不能只靠一刀切。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 护栏要能保护人，也不能把整条路封死。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：法国数字政策。

en-US.headlineFact: France's court rejected a blanket social-media ban for under-15s
en-US.headlineView: child protection must also meet proportionality and privacy safeguards
en-US.headlineFull: France's court rejected a blanket social-media ban for under-15s; child protection must also meet proportionality and privacy safeguards
en-US.intro: France's Constitutional Council found the blanket ban disproportionately restricted expression and privacy and lacked sufficient safeguards for age verification; the government now needs a narrower, workable design.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Protecting minors requires evidence and proportionality, not only a blanket switch.
en-US.doudouQuote: A guardrail should protect people without closing the whole road.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 塔利班掌权五年，人道需求仍覆盖2190万人
zh-CN.headlineView: 妇女限制、返乡潮与干旱继续叠加
zh-CN.headlineFull: 塔利班掌权五年，人道需求仍覆盖2190万人；妇女限制、返乡潮与干旱继续叠加
zh-CN.intro: 联合国估计2026年约2190万人、即45%人口需要人道援助；妇女女孩限制、大规模返乡、干旱、基本服务压力与资金缺口继续累积。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 稳定不能只看战火减少，也要看教育、工作与基本服务能否抵达人。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 地图安静了，生活的难题还在发声。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：阿富汗五年。

en-US.headlineFact: Five years into Taliban rule, 21.9 million still need humanitarian aid
en-US.headlineView: restrictions on women, returns and drought keep compounding
en-US.headlineFull: Five years into Taliban rule, 21.9 million still need humanitarian aid; restrictions on women, returns and drought keep compounding
en-US.intro: The UN estimates 21.9 million people, or 45% of Afghanistan's population, need humanitarian assistance in 2026 as restrictions on women and girls, mass returns, drought, service pressure and funding gaps accumulate.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Stability is not only less fighting; it is whether education, work and basic services reach people.
en-US.doudouQuote: The map is quieter, but daily life is still speaking.

sources.title: The situation in Afghanistan and its implications for international peace and security
